task.description: TEST-DESIGNER (WF-02 Step 3) for REQ-161. ELIXIR-DEV already wrote 100 passing tests in test/letflow/engine/lua/platform_test.exs during Step 2a covering AC1-AC6, and both SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER passed the implementation. Your job is to actively find real coverage gaps using MUTATION TESTING: deliberately break do_fail/2's real code, run the existing suite, and see if it fails. If it doesn't, that's a real gap -- add a test, then revert. This session's track record: mutation testing has repeatedly found real gaps (REQ-155's fixed-sleep race, REQ-156's untested branch, REQ-158's hash blind spot, REQ-159/160's return-value-correct-but-mechanism-unverified gaps). Do the same here. Specific mutation targets: (1) change exit({:script_failed, ...}) to raise Lua.RuntimeException (the OLD hazard this requirement exists to fix) and confirm AC1's pcall-continuation test genuinely catches the regression; (2) mutate the reason/details construction to swap or drop a field and confirm AC2's structured-payload test catches it; (3) mutate the pattern match used to distinguish SCRIPT_FAILED from other exit reasons (if there's a shared helper) or confirm AC3's distinguishability test would catch a tag collision; (4) confirm AC4's empty-capability-set test is exercising a genuinely empty grant set, not accidentally granting something; (5) verify no test silently depends on Executor.execute_with_manifest/2,3's stringification behavior in a way that would mask a regression in the raw exit-reason shape.
acceptance_criteria: Mutation-test AC1: replace exit({:script_failed, ...}) with raise Lua.RuntimeException, confirm the existing pcall-continuation test fails (catches the old hazard), then revert.
Mutation-test AC2: mutate the reason/details map construction (e.g. swap keys, drop a field, hardcode a value), confirm a test catches it, then revert.
Mutation-test AC3: confirm the SCRIPT_FAILED-vs-other-exit-reason distinguishability test would genuinely fail if do_fail/2 used a different/generic tag instead of :script_failed.
Mutation-test AC4: confirm the empty-capability-set test uses a genuinely empty grant set (verify by reading the test's setup, not just its name).
Confirm every one of REQ-161's 7 real acceptance criteria (docs/requirements.yaml) has at least one test that would fail if that specific behavior regressed -- verified by actually breaking it.
Update test/specs/REQ-161.md with the mutation-testing findings table (same format as REQ-159/160's specs).
